title: Bulshadii Ka Hortimid Maalinta Nasashada
intro: U gudub degsiimo xeebeed halkaas oo amar rabbaani ah uu maalin u qoondeeyay cibaadada iyo xakamaynta. Koox ka tirsan bulshadan ayaa dooratay inay tijaabiso xadka amarkaas qorshe xeeladaysan, taasoo horseedaysa isbeddel soo noqnoqon doona qarniyo badan. Yaa ahaa nafahan, maxaase ka dhashay?
clues: Waxaan ku noolayn meel u dhow xeebta, halkaas oo baddu ay naga siin jirtay nolol maalmeedkeenna.
Waxaa nala faray inaan xushmeyno hal maalin oo ka mid ah usbuuca, annagoo ka fogeynayna waxyaabaha adduunyada ah.
Maalintaas, kalluunkii ayaa noo yimid isagoo aad u tiro badan, sidii isagoo naga doonaya inaan jebinno amarka.
Waxaan diyaarinay qorshe aan kalluunka ku qabanno maalinta barakaysan ka hor, ka dibna aan soo ururinno ka dib marka uu dhammaado.
Markii qaar naga mid ah ay ka digeen khiyaanadan, waan iska indho tirnay taladooda oo waan ku adkeysannay.
Xadgudubkeenna awgiis, waxaa naloo beddelay daanyeer, la nacay oo la nacay.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
